name: Will replacing my sliding door require significant structural changes to my older home?

mainEntity.name: Will replacing my sliding door require significant structural changes to my older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most sliding door replacements in older homes do not require major structural changes if the new door fits within the existing opening. However, if you are looking to change the size of the opening, convert a window to a door, or if the existing frame has rot or damage, structural modifications may be necessary. Our team assesses the condition of your current opening during the initial consultation to identify any potential structural requirements and provides transparent recommendations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Significant structural changes are usually not needed if the new door fits the existing opening. Changes are required for altering the opening size or if there's existing frame damage.
